publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
product: Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020. Tabulados del Cuestionario Básico

table.title: Población total por entidad federativa, sexo y denominación religiosa según grupos de edad

columns.E-L: Age breakdown; not used for religion share denominator

table.rowSelection: Sexo = Total; 25 consecutive rows per entity: one Total row plus 24 mutually exclusive denomination/missingness rows. National group begins at row 9; state 01 begins at row 84; each entity block spans 75 rows including male/female rows.
table.geography: 32 entidades federativas, official codes 01-32, including Ciudad de México; national code 00 is stored separately
table.originalFootnote: Incluye una estimación de población de 6 337 751 personas que corresponden a 1 588 422 viviendas sin información de ocupantes y menores omitidos.
table.coverageFootnoteInterpretation: These are INEGI's published final census counts, which incorporate the official census coverage/imputation treatment. No external estimate, projection, interpolated state count, or sample-microdata estimate was introduced.

universe.label: Residentes habituales / Población total
universe.scope: All usual residents of all ages, including private and collective dwelling residents, Mexican Foreign Service population and people without housing in the official census total.
universe.denominatorFormula: The Total denomination row, Sexo=Total, column D for the same entity
universe.displayRounding: Recommend one decimal for principal groups; for very small selected groups retain enough decimals or show <0.1% while preserving exact count.
universe.unknownTreatment: Retain No especificado in populationTotal. Do not renormalize reported religion categories to 100% of specified responses.

meaning.measure: Religion declared in the census, not intensity or practice
meaning.collection: An eligible household informant could answer for household residents; describe as census-declared affiliation rather than every person's direct self-response.
meaning.religionEthnicRoots: Raíces étnicas is a religious category, not an indicator of Indigenous ethnic self-identification.
meaning.religionAfroRoots: Raíces afro is a religious category, not an indicator of Afro-Mexican or Afro-descendant self-identification.

categories.aggregation: Bautista + Presbiteriana + La Luz del Mundo + Adventista del Séptimo Día + Iglesia de Jesucristo de los Santos de los Últimos Días (Mormón) + Testigo de Jehová + Cristiana + Evangélica + Pentecostal + Otro Protestante/cristiano evangélico
categories.interpretation: INEGI's statistical group includes Mormon and Jehovah's Witness denominations; do not reinterpret as a narrower theological Protestant category.

categories.aggregation: Origen oriental + New Age y Escuelas esotéricas + Cultos populares + Otras religiones o movimientos religiosos (the last includes Catholic Orthodox)
categories.warning: This field excludes Judaico, Islámico, Raíces étnicas, Raíces afro and Espiritualista. The presentation chart's same-named Otras religiones aggregate includes those five groups too.

categories.aggregation: Direct workbook row; kept separate from Sin religión
Direct workbook row, not calculated as a residual
categories.interpretation: Unspecified religion includes unrecoverable omissions or inconsistencies; do not describe every case as a refusal.

optionalPresentationAggregate.labelRecommendation: その他の宗教（合計） / Other religious groups, combined
optionalPresentationAggregate.formula: jewish + islamic + ethnic_roots + afro_roots + spiritualist + other_religions
optionalPresentationAggregate.warning: Use a distinct name and do not sum this aggregate with its component fields in a composition chart.

optionalEightCategoryAggregate.labelRecommendation: その他の宗教（民族系・アフリカ系・スピリチュアリズムなど）
optionalEightCategoryAggregate.context: Valid exhaustive eight-category presentation when Catholic, Protestant/Christian Evangelical, Judaico, Islámico, no religion, unaffiliated believer and unspecified remain separate.
optionalEightCategoryAggregate.warning: This is an application aggregation, not the narrow INEGI Otras religiones field (70376) or INEGI's broad presentation chart aggregate (248169). Disclose its components.

validation.independentIterCrosscheck: All 32 entities match independently downloaded ITER: POBTOT=populationTotal, PCATOLICA=catholic, PRO_CRIEVA=protestant_evangelical, POTRAS_REL=sum(jewish,islamic,ethnic_roots,afro_roots,spiritualist,other_religions), PSIN_RELIG=no_religion+unaffiliated_believer. Reported by ethnicity research agent.

indicatorRecommendation.selector: Make principal categories selectable: Catholic; INEGI Protestant/Christian Evangelical group; no religion; believer without affiliation. Other religious groups can be selectable separately or as an explicitly labelled combined aggregate.
indicatorRecommendation.map: A selected group's population share with a numeric sequential scale and explicit legend; state click shows both exact count and share. Preserve the population site's existing selector, metric, state selection and comparison patterns.
indicatorRecommendation.stateDetail: Show the complete religion composition including No especificado and total denominator; provide exact census year and source link.
indicatorRecommendation.avoid: Do not color every state by its majority religion. Do not frame physical geography as determining religious identity, and do not imply every resident follows the mapped affiliation.

reuse.allowed: Extraction, adaptation, redistribution, publication and commercial reuse are permitted under INEGI's free-use terms.
reuse.requirements: Keep source metadata; credit INEGI and the original product; disclose aggregations and percentage calculations to the end user; do not imply INEGI performed or endorsed those transformations.
reuse.creditRecommendation: Fuente: INEGI, Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020. Tabulados del Cuestionario Básico. Agrupaciones y porcentajes calculados a partir de los conteos publicados.
